title: Protocol using lentivirus to establish THP-1 suspension cell lines for immunostaining and confocal microscopy
protocol: Remove culture medium from confluent HEK293T cells.
Rinse the cells briefly with 5 mL PBS to remove traces of serum.
Add 2–3 mL of 0.05% trypsin - 0.53 mM EDTA solution to the dish and incubate at room temperature for 2–5 minutes until the cell layer is dispersed.
Aspirate the cells by gently pipetting after adding 5 mL complete growth medium.
Seed appropriate cells (3.5–3.8 × 10^6) in a new 10 cm cell culture dish to achieve 80% confluence within 24 hours.
Incubate seeded HEK293T cells at 37°C, 5% CO2.
Add 6 μg retroviral vector (control or gene of interest for KO) to a 1.5 mL centrifugation tube.
Add 6 μg psPAX2 and 3 μg pCMV-VSV-G to the tube with the retroviral vector.
Mix all components in the tube with 400 μL serum-free DMEM.
Incubate HEK293T cells at 37°C, 5% CO2 for transfection.
Add 60 μL PEI to a 1.5 mL centrifugation tube.
Mix the PEI with 400 μL serum-free DMEM in the tube, naming it as tube B.
Combine the mixture from tube B with the contents of tube A by thorough mixing using a 1 mL pipette.
Incubate the combined mixture at room temperature (20°C–25°C) for 20 min.
Add the incubated mixture to a 10 cm cell culture dish containing HEK293T cells that are 80% confluent.
Gently swirl the cell culture dish several times to ensure even distribution of the mixture.
Incubate the cells at 37°C, with 5% CO2 for 6 hours.
Replace the medium in the cell culture dish with 10 mL prewarmed DMEM containing 10% FBS.
Allow the cells to grow for 2 days.
Transfer the supernatant (10 mL) into a 15 mL centrifugation tube.
Centrifuge at 160×g for 15 minutes at 4°C.
Carefully transfer the supernatant to a new 15 mL centrifugation tube.
Filter the supernatant with a 0.22 μm filter.
Add ViraTrap™ Lentivirus Concentration Reagent (2.5 mL) to the filtered supernatant.
Mix thoroughly by pipetting.
Incubate the mixture at 4°C for 8–16 hours.
Centrifuge the mixture at 650×g for 20 minutes at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant, leaving the white pellet at the bottom of the tube.
Repeat steps 6 and 7 as necessary.
Resuspend the white pellet using 0.5–1.0 mL RPMI-1640 medium with 10% FBS.
Resuspend THP-1 cells (3×10^5 cells) with 1 mL RPMI-1640 containing concentrated virus.
Transfer the mixture to a 12 well plate (1 mL per well).
Incubate at 37°C, 5% CO2 for 6 h.
Replace the medium with prewarmed complete RPMI-1640 medium.
Deactivate any remaining virus in the replaced medium by soaking it in sodium hypochlorite solution (0.02–0.05%).
After 48 h, replace the medium again with prewarmed complete RPMI-1640 medium containing 2 μg/mL puromycin.
Incubate at 37°C, 5% CO2.
Change fresh medium 2–3 times if necessary during cell screening.
Wait for completion of cell screening, which takes approximately 7–10 days.
Perform monoclonal cell line generation by limited dilution method when cells proliferate normally.
Place the glass coverslip in a 12 well plate.
Add 1 mL THP-1 cells (2×10^6 cells) to the coverslip.
Ensure the glass coverslip is fully attached to the bottom of the 12 well plate.
Centrifuge the 12 well plate at 120×g for 20 minutes.
Gently remove the 12 well plate from the centrifuge and wash 3–5 times using PBS.
Add 1 mL of 4% paraformaldehyde to fix cells at 120×g for 20 minutes.
Aspirate 4% paraformaldehyde carefully.
Add 1 mL of 0.1% Triton X-100 and permeabilize cells at 120×g for 10 minutes.
Gently remove the 12 well plate from the centrifuge and wash 3–5 times using PBS.
Add 1 mL 3% BSA to the 12 well plate containing fixed THP-1 cells.
Incubate at room temperature for 2 h.
Wash 2 times using PBS.
Add 400 μL primary antibody (anti-STING, Proteintech, 19851-1-AP, 1:100).
Incubate at room temperature for 2 h.
Wash 4–5 times using PBS.
Add 400 μL TRITC-conjugated donkey anti-rabbit IgG (Jackson ImmunoResearch Laboratories, 1:100).
Incubate at room temperature for 2 h, protected from light.
Wash 4–5 times using PBS.
Mount the coverslips onto glass slides using antifade mounting medium with DAPI.
